parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

*   zh: Chinese
*   en: English

parameters.name: Language
parameters.description: The programming language of the application, such as Java and Go.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description: The microservice namespace to which the application belongs.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the page to return.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page.

parameters.name: SentinelEnable
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable the Sentinel-compatible mode.

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description: The source of the application. The value is fixed as edasmsc.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mse get-application-list --biz-region cn-hangzhou --app-name rest-container --app-id hkhon1po62@c3df23522b00000 --source edasmsc --biz-language Java --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --switch-enable true --sentinel-enable true --namespace default --tags Value=tagValue Key=tagKey --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun mse GetApplicationList --region cn-hangzhou --AppId 'hkhon1po62@c3df23522b00000' --Language Java --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --SwitchEnable true --Region 'cn-hangzhou' --AcceptLanguage zh --Source edasmsc --Namespace default --Tags '[{"Value":"tagValue","Key":"tagKey"}]' --AppName 'rest-container' --SentinelEnable true
